lines: 1. BOOK ALL FLIGHTS THROUGH THE TRAVEL PORTAL.
ECONOMY CLASS FOR FLIGHTS UNDER 6 HOURS, PREMIUM ECONOMY ABOVE THAT.
2. HOTELS: UP TO $180 PER NIGHT IN MOST CITIES, $260 IN HIGH-COST CITIES.
3. MEALS: A PER DIEM OF $65 FOR EACH TRAVEL DAY.
NO RECEIPTS ARE NEEDED FOR MEALS COVERED BY THE PER DIEM.
4. RECEIPTS ARE REQUIRED FOR EVERY OTHER ITEM OVER $25.
5. SUBMIT CLAIMS WITHIN 30 DAYS OF RETURNING.
LATE CLAIMS NEED APPROVAL FROM THE FINANCE DIRECTOR.
6. TRIPS EXPECTED TO COST OVER $3,000 NEED PRE-APPROVAL FROM A VP
